why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: Check you're allowed. The terms say you must not be "a resident of, or located in, any restricted or sanctioned jurisdiction", but they give no list of countries.
Set up a wallet that works on ZIGChain, such as Keplr, or use an Ethereum wallet for the Ethereum vaults.
Open the Valdora leaderboard , connect your wallet (100 points) and verify a follow of the official X account, @Valdora_finance (100 points).

To stake: get ZIG, move it to ZIGChain and stake it on valdora.finance/stake for stZIG. "The minimum amount required to stake on Valdora is 50 ZIG." Warning The docs say: "Sending to the wrong chain may result in permanent loss of funds." Check the network before every transfer.

To use a vault: bridge USDC to ZIGChain through hub.zigchain.com, or pick an Ethereum vault. Read the vault page, especially its redemption period, then deposit. Your first deposit and reaching $10 in total add 300 start points.
Optionally hold both staked ZIG and a vault for the 1.25x combo. Your referral link is in the Refer and Earn tab.
Check My Points on the leaderboard the next day, as points are counted once a day.
costs: This isn't free. Apart from the first 200 start points, every point needs money in a vault or ZIG staked. The vaults charge "a 0% performance fee on yield". Staking takes a cut: "10% performance fee is applied to staking rewards (not user principal)." Unstaking can cost extra: "Unstaking ZIG on Valdora may include a fee that varies based on the amount of stZIG being unstaked." You also pay gas on
risks: You can lose your deposit. The terms say "you may lose some or all of your deposited capital". The docs list "strategy risk, credit risk, market risk, liquidity risk, and smart contract risk." The risk labels don't match. The vaults page says "Earning safe, real-world yields on" and marks every vault low risk, while the docs call Opportunistic Credit "the higher-yield, higher-variability counterpa
